rules.Windshield crack: Cracks in the wiper sweep area fail the inspection. Replace the windscreen before retest.
rules.Headlamp haze: Reduced light output. Headlamp beam test will confirm; polish or replace the lens.
rules.Panel misalignment: Uneven gaps can mean a past repair. Recorded for the body history.
rules.Uneven tyre wear: Points to wheel alignment or suspension issues. Check alignment.
rules.Sidewall bulge: Internal tyre damage. Unsafe to drive: tyre must be replaced.
rules.Tail lamp crack: Cracked lens lets water in and can show white light to the rear. Replace the lens.
rules.Rear door misalignment: Door gap out of line. Check hinges and latch for safety.
rules.Water staining: Water marks on the floor are a flood indicator.
rules.Tide line: A level line of dirt on trim shows how high water stood inside the car.
rules.Seat rail corrosion: Rust on seat rails is a strong sign of standing water in the cabin.
rules.Loose heat shield: Can rattle or fall off. Re-secure before retest.
rules.Bracket corrosion: Corroded exhaust hanger can fail. Monitor or replace.
rules.Dent: Cosmetic unless near a structural member. Recorded for the body history.
rules.Scratch: Cosmetic. Recorded for the body history.
rules.Rust: Surface rust near the wheel arch. Treat before it becomes structural.
rules.Fluid leak: Active oil or transmission leak fails the inspection. Repair and retest.
rules.Surface wear: Normal wear. Useful as an odometer cross-check: heavy wear with low mileage is suspicious.
rules.Wear: Normal wear. Consistent with the recorded mileage.
rules.Disc scoring: Deep grooves reduce braking grip. Skim or replace the disc.
rules.Uneven pad wear: Inner pad much thinner than outer: sticking caliper. Causes brake imbalance, a fail item.
rules.Visible smoke: Smoke at idle fails the emissions test. Find the cause before retest.
rules.Soot deposit: Rich running or oil burning. Supports the smoke finding.
rules.Oil-wet shock absorber: A leaking shock has lost damping. Fail item: replace in pairs.
rules.Cracked bush: Worn mount lets the axle move. Replace with the shocks.
rules.Camera mount tilted: A tilted camera misjudges lanes and distance. Recalibrate.
rules.Recalibration not recorded: New windscreen with no calibration record. Ask for proof or recalibrate.
rules.Terminal corrosion: Raises resistance and weakens starting. Clean and protect.
rules.Case swelling: Swollen case means internal damage or overcharging. Replace the battery.
rules.Pad thickness 5 mm: Above the 3 mm limit. Pass, and monitor the wear rate.

cases.title: Lane 3 · Case 1
cases.next_step: Pass with an advisory to treat the rust. Dent and scratch go on the body history for future buyers.

cases.title: Lane 3 · Case 2
cases.next_step: Pass with an advisory: repair the bumper dent and treat the rust at the wheel arch before it spreads. The scratch goes on the body history.

cases.title: Lane 3 · Case 3
cases.next_step: Cosmetic only. Pass. Recorded on the vehicle health passport.

cases.title: Lane 3 · Case 4
cases.next_step: Cosmetic hail or impact dent. Pass. Recorded for the body history.

cases.title: Lane 3 · Case 5
cases.next_step: Fail item. Confirm with the e-nose (oil vapour) and send the owner a repair notice. Retest within 30 days.

cases.title: Close-up · Brakes
cases.next_step: Fail item. This matches the rising brake imbalance on VKR 3128. Replace disc and pads, service the caliper, retest on the roller tester.

cases.title: Close-up · Emissions
cases.next_step: Fail item. Matches the rising HC readings on BHY 7783. Injector and compression check, then re-run the emissions test.

cases.title: Close-up · Suspension
cases.next_step: Fail item. Explains the falling rear damping on JTR 5510. Replace both rear shocks and the bushes.

cases.title: Close-up · ADAS camera
cases.next_step: Advisory. Explains the step change in camera yaw on PKE 4410 after the windscreen swap. Recalibrate at a panel ADAS bay.

cases.title: Close-up · 12 V battery
cases.next_step: Advisory. Matches the falling cranking voltage on VJM 7412. Replace the battery at the next service.

cases.title: Close-up · Brake pads
cases.next_step: Pass. 5 mm is above the 3 mm limit. At the current wear rate, plan pads in about 6 months.

cases.next_step: Pass with advisory. Fleet manager gets a rust-treatment recommendation.

cases.title: Fleet case 2
cases.next_step: Pass with advisory. Schedule body repair at the next service.

cases.title: Fleet case 3
cases.next_step: Fail item. Take the vehicle off the road roster until the leak is fixed; book a retest.

cases.title: Fleet case 4
cases.next_step: Cosmetic. Pass.

cases.title: Fleet case 5
cases.next_step: Cabin wear matches the recorded mileage, so no odometer concern. Pass.

cases.next_step: Cosmetic. Pass.

cases.next_step: Fail item. Replace the windscreen and retest. Fleet portal flags the vehicle.

cases.next_step: Run the headlamp beam test. The gap suggests a past front-right repair; check the insurance history.

cases.title: Fleet case 9
cases.next_step: Fail item: replace the front-right tyre now, then check wheel alignment to stop the uneven wear.

cases.next_step: Three flood signs together. Run the e-nose for mould and electrolyte, check the insurance record, and refer for a flood assessment.
